title: Extend sequence audition duration
changes: Allow sequence previews from one to 180 seconds, with bounded per-track work and paginated note tables.
Schedule audio progressively with a short lookahead, cancel future work on stop and report notes delayed or skipped when browser scheduling falls behind.
validation: Real-time synthetic Chrome unit rom-data-viewer-longaudio-a5q2rn7d checked duration limits, note pages, progressive scheduling, cancellation and late-note reporting; PCM tkh5huj_ and mix ehd71h0c regression units passed.
Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-longaudio-eur-jds4jb_h checked a thirty-second twelve-track preview, a 180-second bounded trace and scheduler stop in Linux Chrome.
limitations: Timing remains user-selected and playback is an approximation; browser throttling can delay or skip notes. Original driver tempo, envelopes, effects and physical audio remain unverified.
EUR attempt chfeg5l1 did not start audio because the automated browser lacked its autoplay test flag; the corrected test passed.
